sections.text:
Juha quarreled with a man from his village, so they went to the judge to rule between them.

The judge was known to love gifts and bribes before he issued his ruling.

Juha thought of a trick, brought a large jar, filled it with dirt and stones, put a layer of pure honey on its surface, and presented it to the judge as a gift!
The judge was very happy with the gift, and ruled in favor of Juha immediately without listening to the other party.

Days later, the judge wanted to eat some honey, so he inserted his spoon into the jar to discover that it was full of dirt!
The judge became very angry and sent for Juha.

When Juha appeared before him, the judge said threateningly: “You cunning one! The honey you gave me was rotten from the inside!”

Juha replied calmly and with a smile: “What is my fault, Your Honor? You judged me as soon as you saw the honey from the outside, just as you judged me on the outside without examining the truth from the inside!”

It was dropped into the hands of the judge and he had no answer.
